ATTACHED TABLE — Regulations on the Organization of Military Prosecutors' Offices

Ranks and Numbers of Military Prosecutors Assigned to the Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office and Military Prosecutors' Offices of Each Armed Service (Related to Article 6 (2))

(Unit: persons)

Office | Brigadier General | Colonel | Lieutenant Colonel or Major | Captain or Below | Total
Ministry of National Defense Prosecutors' Office | 1 | 1 | 8 | 6 | 16
Army Prosecutors' Office | — | 2 | 28 | 17 | 47
Navy Prosecutors' Office | — | 1 | 6 | 16 | 23
Air Force Prosecutors' Office | — | 1 | 9 | 9 | 19
Total | 1 | 5 | 51 | 48 | 105

The table reproduces all rank categories, organizational allocations and totals visible in the supplied Korean text. A dash denotes the blank (no allocation) in the source table. The original attached document has not been separately examined.
